reason: The surgical cut-mode recheck adds four isolated, tested runtime policy modules: spoken-audio Factory execution, fail-closed legacy ENG/cache replay source handling, Telegram-accepted cached replay delivery evidence, and a no-downgrade exact-boundary policy. The last module adds one narrowly scoped canonical Gemini-model regex with dedicated regression tests and no editorial postprocess debt.

evidence.quality_contract: Factory selects Russian versus Yandex LiveDub only after Gemini has heard the audio; unknown language fails closed; every proven non-Russian language requires LiveDub; partial Telegram delivery is reported truthfully; legacy ENG cuts cannot silently render the untranslated original; valid analysis cache becomes a no-publication replay; only Telegram-accepted cut videos count as replay success; Gemini must be canonical Pro >=3.1; Whisper must be exact large-v3; configured quality, timing, disk and timeout floors cannot be lowered; fractional Gemini boundaries survive validation; and Factory rendering cannot perform a second silence-snap after the final boundary audit.

regex_evidence.purpose: Validate canonical gemini-<version>-pro model identifiers and reject aliases that merely contain the word pro.
